info.name: Amazon ElastiCache API
info.description:
Amazon ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory caching service supporting Redis and Memcached for improving the performance of web applications.

Contact Support:
 Name: Kin Lane
 Email: kin@apievangelist.com

request.description: Creates a cache cluster. All nodes in the cache cluster run the same protocol-compliant cache engine software, either Memcached or Redis.

response.name: Successful response with the created cache cluster details.
